newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Two persons burned to death after a gas explosion in the south HUngarian town of Szeged.
- Today a second petrol price increase within two weeks was implemented.
- The four billion forints government bailout would not cover all hospital debts, the hospitals said.
- Hungary and the Czech Republic will coordinate they efforts to join the European Union, the two foreign ministers agrred in Prague.
- The Hungarian and Croat parliament are both satisfied about the conditions of the Hungarian minority in Croatia and vice versa.
